Definition

DEF-0003 Single fault condition

TitleSingle fault condition
Abbreviation—
SourceREF-0002

Definition

A condition in which one means of reducing a risk has failed, or one abnormal condition is present, while every other protective means still works. The system must stay safe in any single fault condition.
